name: Ink Transition
description: Vertical storytelling page with a liquid-warp title that settles in and images that bloom open through an ink-edged mask, each followed by fading bilingual captions on scroll.
contents: List of sections, each with an image, a Korean caption, a divider and an English caption
behavior: Title fades in and its SVG liquify distortion relaxes to zero after an initial delay once visible
Each image reveals through a growing radial mask with a rough ink edge when it enters the viewport
Captions slide up and fade in with per-section delays on entering the viewport
editableByProps: Title, all captions, images, alt text and number of sections
Image sizes per section through sizeClass, reveal delays per caption
Fonts, Tailwind color classes, container width
Liquify and ink edge strength, reveal duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the mask shape or final reveal size

needsCodeEdit.where: duration and delay constants in the second useEffect

fixed: Renders a placeholder until mounted, then the full page
Title intro delay (800ms) and duration (2200ms) are hardcoded
Sections are stacked vertically in a single centered column
